==Overview==
==={{OoT|-}}===
{{Main|Water Temple (Ocarina of Time)}}
The Water Temple is the seventh [[Dungeon]] located at the bottom of [[Lake Hylia]]. Its main [[Item]] is the [[Longshot]] and its [[Boss]] is [[Morpha]].

==={{TFH|-}}===
{{Main|Water Temple (Tri Force Heroes)}}
The Water Temple is the fourth and last [[Level]] of the [[Riverside]] Area, preceded by [[Cove of Transition]]. Its [[Boss]] is [[Arrghus]].

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Main|Water Temple (Tears of the Kingdom)}}
{{Quests|
{{TotK Quest
 |name= Regional Phenomena
 |type= Main Quest
 |giver= [[Purah]]
 |location= [[Lookout Landing]]
}}
{{TotK Quest
 |name= Sidon of the Zora
 |type= Main Quest
 |giver= [[Yona]]
 |location= [[Zora's Domain]]
}}
}}
{{Stub|TotK}}
The Water Temple is located on top of [[Wellspring Island]] in the [[Lanayru Great Spring Sky]]. Its [[Boss]] is [[Mucktorok]].

==Other Appearances==
==={{HW|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
The Water Temple appears as part of the [[Lake Hylia (Stage)|Lake Hylia]] [[Stage]] in {{HW}}. This stage is a part of [[Sheik]] and [[Impa]]'s quest to close the [[Gate of Souls]] located inside the temple. An updated version of [[Dark Link]]'s chamber appears, where [[Wizzro]], disguised as Zelda, is fought.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{DotT|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
Though the Water Temple is never seen during {{DotT}}, a [[Sign]] stating that the Real Escape Game was "Easier than the Water Temple" was used as a prop during photo shoots with the [[Master Sword]] at {{DotT|-}} events.<ref name="DotT Sign"/>
{{Noncanon|End}}
